scenes.text: Almost every modern AI, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, even many image and music models, is built on one design from 2017, the transformer. [1] And its secret ingredient is called attention. [2] So let's understand it, in part one.

Attention is the idea that each word can look at every other word, and decide which ones matter. [1] It's how a model understands context. [2] Each word asks, which other words help explain me? [3] It gives those words more weight, [4] and builds its meaning from them.

data.definition: Each word looks at every other word and decides which ones matter for its meaning.

scenes.text: Here's an example. Take the word bank. [1] In, I sat on the river bank, attention links bank to river, so it means the side of a river. [2] In, I deposited money in the bank, attention links bank to money, and deposited. [3] Same word, different meaning, and attention works it out from context.

So why was this such a big deal? [1] Older models read text one word at a time, and often forgot the start of long passages. [2] Transformers look at all the words at once, so they capture long range meaning, and train much faster on powerful chips.

Here are a few terms. [1] Self attention, where words in the same sentence look at each other. [2] Attention weights, how strongly one word focuses on another. [3] Multi head attention, many attention patterns at once, like one for grammar, and one for meaning. [4] And parallel processing, handling all the words together.

So where are transformers used? [1] In chatbots and LLMs, like ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. [2] In translation, which is actually where transformers started. [3] And even in images and audio, where patches and sound tokens attend to each other.

Here's a common myth. [1] People think attention means the AI is focusing, like a person paying attention. [2] It's just maths, a way of computing how related each word is to every other word. The name is a helpful metaphor, not a sign of awareness.

data.myth: Attention means the AI is consciously focusing.
data.fact: It's maths: computing how related each word is to every other word. The name is a metaphor.

scenes.text: Quick quiz! In the sentence, I sat on the river bank, which word helps the model understand bank? [1] Pause and think, and if you get it right, comment below! <pause 3.2> [2] River! Attention links bank to river, so it means a riverside.

data.question: In “I sat on the river bank”, bank is explained by…

scenes.text: Let's recap. [1] Attention lets every word look at every other word. [2] Context decides the meaning. [3] Transformers read all the words at once, not one at a time. [4] And they power text, image and audio models. [5] In part two, we'll see how a transformer turns attention into a full answer. Follow AI Maastaaru!

points: not one word at a time
